text: Astronomy is the study of celestial objects and phenomena that occur outside the Earth's atmosphere. One of the first and most significant discoveries in astronomy was the existence of the Sun. The Sun is a star that provides light and heat to Earth, and its gravity pulls everything in the solar system towards it. The Moon is also a celestial body that is in orbit around the Earth, and it has craters, mountains, and valleys that scientists use to study the geological processes on Earth. The solar system also includes other planets, such as Mars, which has a large amount of craters from meteor impacts and volcanic activity. In conclusion, astronomy is an exciting and fascinating field that helps us understand the universe around us and how it works.
